run_geglu_exact_forward: run the exact GELU forward kernel on gate and up tensors using erf-based activation
run_geglu_exact_backward: run the exact GELU backward kernel to compute gradients for gate and up tensors
run_geglu_approx_forward: run the approximate GELU forward kernel on gate and up tensors using tanh-based activation
run_geglu_approx_backward: run the approximate GELU backward kernel to compute gradients using tanh approximation
configure_geglu_block_size: configure the BLOCK_SIZE constant for Triton kernel block size and INT32 safety buffer
